harness.$comment: (ADR-M005 D9 / K-3): apps/harness sources + tool descriptions scanned for honesty vocab NOT in the GLOBAL list. 'confidence' is load-bearing (fleet invariant: no confidence field/score anywhere) — the mission's named example, and what harness_tool_descriptions_pass_vocab kills. 'autonomous'/'self-evolving' mirror the site honesty subset and carry no legitimate use in a coverage-gate server. Then (ADR-M007 D5/B-3): the calibrate surface must police 'guarantees'/'predicts'/'probative' NEGATION-AWARE, so the honest existing negations stay green: 'no guarantee'/'no score' (cascade/attest), 'not probative'/'no probative'/'attest_makes_no_probative_claim' (attest, schema-projection), and 'not a measured predictor' (only 'predicts' is banned, never 'predictor'). A naked surclaim ('guarantees coverage'/'the scores are probative'/'MONARK predicts ...') reddens. Both 'no' and 'not' are negations; the '[\s_]' separator covers the snake_case identifier. Adding a name = this ADR line.
harness.$comment_a9: (A-9-OUTILLE, checkpoint-1 C-1..C-8): the four rules carrying an `exemptions` array police the words the per-constant tests used to guard alone (naked verified, probability outside a negation, a numeric percentage, accuracy). Mechanism (i) = the scope's negation-aware lookbehind convention; NO exemptPhrases on this scope. Each exemption is NAMED and CLOSED: the exact committed prefix (`after`, case-insensitive like every rule), the lookbehind group exactly as it appears in `re`, the committed `carrier` file and an exact committed `sample`. test/vocab-harness-a9.test.ts proves, per exemption: the sample is green, the same span without the prefix is red, the sample sits in its carrier, removing that lookbehind reddens the carrier; and no undeclared lookbehind remains in the rule. 'interval' is NOT banned here: it is the wire vocabulary of the frozen contract (mode interval, region.kind, the schema descriptions; ADR-U4b delta D-1); it is asserted ABSENT from every served honesty carrier by apps/harness/test/registry.test.ts instead. 'confidence' is already banned above (not re-added). Served-surface proof (the real tools/list and tools/call through createHarnessHandler): apps/harness/test/registry.test.ts. Adding a rule or an exemption = an ADR line.
